content.comment_body: Nuremberg, Germany, February 2011. A new range of [product_name] logic modules has been introduced by [company_name], now featuring integrated Ethernet interfaces. Two new base devices, [product_name] with networking capabilities, expand the [company_name] offering for more advanced applications. Performance upgrades include doubled program capacity to 400 function blocks and several new practical features such as macro functions for recurring sequences and data logging for documentation purposes. Up to eight new modules can be connected via standard Ethernet switches. With the addition of Ethernet and an SD card reader, the new modules measure six modular widths (108mm). The original four-width devices are still available for simpler tasks.

Thanks for sharing this update, [user_name]. Finally, we get the highly requested hardware upgrade: Ethernet connectivity. Should we refer to this as [product_name] [version_no]? I predict the forum will become very active once these new modules are launched.

Hello everyone! This is some of the best news in [product_name]'s history. I've heard that the current [article_no] models will continue unchanged, without new features. The two new Ethernet-enabled modules will be added to the existing family. They will be called [product_name] [version_no], and a new software version, [product_name] [version_no], will support all units. I'm curious if full support will be available on Windows 7 (32 & 64 bit). Looking forward to seeing new applications at the industry fair! Very exciting. Wondering about the price, though.
The new module looks promising! Does anyone know when it will be released?
I've heard rumors about a summer release... hoping it's soon, can't wait to get my hands on it!
Hello all. Information about the modules is now on the [product_name] logic module website. More functions for [product_name] [version_no] in the updated software.
Thanks for the update, I'm really excited about these new modules. I think they're going to be very popular.
Thank you for this information, we're eager for more updates!
Hello everyone! This is interesting... Does anyone know when these will be available in Asia, especially the Philippines?
Hello all, At the Hanover fair, [company_name] representatives mentioned that delivery is scheduled for early July. Hope this helps.
Thank you... really need these new modules as soon as possible!
Hello all, I've found a brochure covering both [product_name] [version_no]. You can check the link or attached file: [url]
Additionally, [product_name] [version_no] enables data exchange with other devices over Industrial Ethernet (see page 5).

analysis.insight_summary: The release of new [product_name] logic modules featuring integrated Ethernet connectivity has sparked excitement and anticipation in the forum. Users are pleased with improved capacity, new macro and data logging functions, and long-awaited Ethernet support. There is curiosity about software compatibility with popular operating systems, global availability, and pricing, but overall user sentiment remains very positive regarding the modules' expanded functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the new modules to offer Ethernet connectivity, upgraded capacity, advanced features, compatibility with widely used operating systems, and fast global availability.
